detail: The published response examples use text.format.type=text and output[].type=message. Their discriminators omit mappings to the actual schema names; the validator resolves nonexistent #/components/schemas/text and #/components/schemas/message. The unmodified provider examples are accepted by the node in direct parser regression tests.

ChatCompletionRequestMessage declares a role discriminator without mappings. OpenAI documents role=developer and role=user, but the contract resolves these to nonexistent #/components/schemas/developer and #/components/schemas/user rather than ChatCompletionRequestDeveloperMessage and ChatCompletionRequestUserMessage. The node sends the documented wire values.
